title: Demo Snowboard Rental Package for Snowbasin and Powder Mountain
includes: Park City or Deer Valley shop pick-up (not included)
Damage insurance: $3 - $4 based on item (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Adult riders must have a shoe size 7 and up to be accommodated with this package
policies: You are permitted to pick up your gear the night before you ride after 4pm, so you can enjoy a full day on the slopes. You have until 10:00 am the day after your final ski day to return the gear.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Demo Snowboard Package - the latest and greatest available in snowboarding equipment for the season. Burton, K2, and Lib Tech w Tip Rocker in various graphics to please the most advanced riders and make a novice look like a pro. Includes K2 Boa boots and bindings. A full-day rental, plus time to relax and return the gear.
